name: 312deals
title: 312Deals — Chicago Food & Drink Deals
description: MCP server exposing 11 tools for searching Chicago food & drink deals — happy hours, daily specials, brunch, late-night, game day, chain app deals — across {{neighborhoods}} city + suburban neighborhoods. {{deals}} verified deals at {{venues}} venues, updated weekly.

license.type: Free use; bulk copying or resale prohibited

transports.title: Local install (recommended today)
transports.description: Clone the chideals repo and run the FastMCP server locally. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, and any MCP client supporting stdio transport.

install.claude_desktop: claude mcp add chideals -- python -m src.mcp_server.chideals_mcp
install.manual: git clone https://github.com/ChristianVerdin/chideals && cd chideals && pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m src.mcp_server.chideals_mcp
requires: Local SQLite database (data/chideals.db) bundled in repo

remote_endpoint_note: A remote HTTP-streamable endpoint for the data MCP (the 11 tools listed below) is planned but not yet live. Use the stdio transport above. For browser-native agents, use WebMCP at /.well-known/webmcp.json. For documentation-focused agent interaction, see `companion_servers` below.

companion_servers.name: 312Deals Docs MCP (Mintlify-hosted)
companion_servers.purpose: Read-only search and file access across 312Deals documentation (guides, API reference, OpenAPI specs). Complementary to this data MCP — use it for 'how does X work' or 'where is Y documented' queries.

tools.name: search_312_deals
tools.description: Keyword/semantic search across the 312Deals docs knowledge base. Returns contextual content with titles and direct links.

tools.name: query_docs_filesystem_312_deals
tools.description: Read-only shell-like query (rg / grep / cat / head / tree / find / jq) against a virtualized in-memory filesystem of all 312Deals docs pages and OpenAPI specs.

rate_limits.note: Free tier — please cache identical queries for 5+ minutes.

coverage.geographic: Chicago IL metro — {{neighborhoods}} neighborhoods (Chicago city + suburbs)

tools.name: search_chicago_deals
tools.description: Find food and drink deals across {{neighborhoods}} Chicago neighborhoods and suburbs. Filters: neighborhood, day, deal_type, cuisine, free-text query, price range, active_now.

tools.name: deals_near_location
tools.description: Find deals near a Chicago address or lat/lng — geo-proximity search with optional active-now filter.

tools.name: get_venue_details
tools.description: Look up a single venue by slug or name; returns full venue metadata plus all current deals.

tools.name: get_chicago_neighborhoods
tools.description: List all {{neighborhoods}} neighborhoods (Chicago city + suburbs) with deal/venue counts.

tools.name: chicago_deal_of_the_day
tools.description: Today's highest-quality verified deal active right now — optionally scoped to a zone (city, north_shore, northwest_suburbs, western_suburbs, south_suburbs).

tools.name: chicago_chain_deals
tools.description: National chain deals in Chicago — McDonald's, Chipotle, BWW, Portillo's, etc. Optional app-only filter.

tools.name: plan_chicago_deal_crawl
tools.description: Multi-stop bar crawl planner — optimizes route, timing, and savings across a neighborhood.

tools.name: submit_deal_tip
tools.description: Submit a new deal for verification (human-in-the-loop).

tools.name: find_best_deal_now
tools.description: Single highest-value deal happening right now, optionally near a location or in a neighborhood.

tools.name: compare_neighborhoods
tools.description: Side-by-side deal-scene comparison — venue count, deal count, top deal types, average savings.

tools.name: weekly_deals_digest
tools.description: Curated weekly digest — top new deals, seasonal launches, and neighborhood highlights.
